fields.value: Lumen Water is a regional water utility. Customers rarely think about water until a bill arrives.

territories.tier_reason: Close to what the category already says, so it is easy to explain.
territories.proposition: Let the tap speak for the household.
territories.tension_text: People value water but never link it to their own tap.
territories.mechanism: A tap that tells each household a small story about its own day.

territories.tier_reason: Asks the audience to look at a number it has never seen.
territories.tension_text: Use is easy to ignore because nobody sees it.
territories.mechanism: A household counter that turns daily use into something you can see.

territories.tier_reason: Gives the water network a voice, which the category has not done.
territories.proposition: Hear the network that never stops working.
territories.tension_text: The network is trusted because it is never noticed.
territories.mechanism: Sound from the pipes under the street, played back above ground.
